channel.title: Israel National News Flashes
channel.description: Latest news flashes from Israel National News

item.title: President Herzog opens October 7 memorial events with candle-lighting at 6:29 a.m.
item.description: President Isaac Herzog and his wife, Michal, open Israel’s October 7 memorial events by lighting a candle at 6:29 a.m. at the President’s Residence.

item.title: IDF transforms operations, expands reserves, implements sweeping reforms post-Oct. 7
item.description: IDF data reveals the scale of three years of fighting and sweeping reforms in intelligence, border defense, reserves and military readiness.

item.title: Netanyahu, Smotrich to meet rabbis to strengthen right-wing bloc
item.description: Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Bezalel Smotrich will meet with rabbis in Jerusalem on Thursday as efforts intensify to consolidate the right-wing bloc ahead of elections.

item.title: Akunis invites Mamdani to watch October 7 massacre film
item.description: Akunis invites Mamdani to watch October 7 massacre film

item.title: Is Sydney Sweeney considering converting to Judaism?
item.description: Page Six reports that Sydney Sweeney is considering converting to Judaism amid her relationship with Jewish music producer Scooter Braun.

item.description: Report: Flydubai terrorist trained as a pilot in Britain

item.title: Sweden: Police shoot armed man outside Royal Palace
item.description:
Swedish police shot an armed man outside the Royal Palace in the capital, Stockholm.
Police said officers were called to the scene following reports of “a person causing a disturbance and armed with a weapon."

item.title: Vance: Iran must make 'meaningful' nuclear concessions to end war
item.description: Vance: Iran must make 'meaningful' nuclear concessions to end war

item.title: 40-year-old man seriously injured in a violent incident in Givat Chen
item.description:
A man in his 40s was injured overnight in a violent incident in Givat Chen.
Magen David Adom (MDA) teams provided him with medical treatment and evacuated him to Meir Hospital in serious condition.

item.title: Texas Gov. Abbott orders flags lowered in memory of October 7 victims
item.description: Texas Governor Greg Abbott orders US and Texas flags lowered to half-staff to honor the victims of Hamas’ October 7 massacre, on the third anniversary of the attack.

item.title: 'It can never be erased': Israel marks October 7 anniversary at the UN
item.description: Israel’s UN mission marks three years since October 7 with Eliya Cohen and Ziv Abud sharing their story as US envoy Mike Waltz vows it won’t happen again.

item.title: Reports from Gaza: Explosion in eastern Gaza City, fighter jets flying at low altitude
item.description:
Arab channels report that IDF forces detonated an explosive device in the eastern part of the Tuffah neighborhood in Gaza City. Columns of smoke were seen in the area following the explosion.
It was also reported that Israeli fighter jets are flying at low altitude over the Gaza Strip and releasing flares.

item.title: Satellite images reveal: Iran has resumed activity at nuclear site struck by Israel
item.description: Recent satellite images indicate a major resumption of activity at Minzadei, a nuclear weapons development site in Iran that was struck by Israel.

item.title: Trump: Iran war will end 'pretty soon', you’ll find out how
item.description: President Trump predicts the Iran war will end “pretty soon", adding: “They’re not a bully anymore."

item.title: Class action lawsuit against Rami Levy approved
item.description: Labor Court approves class action against Rami Levy over allegations that the supermarket chain deducted cash register shortages from cashiers’ salaries.

item.title: Zini warns the security cabinet about developments in the Bedouin sector
item.description: Shin Bet chief David Zini warned of 'very concerning' attempts to establish 'quasi-military' frameworks in the Bedouin sector.

item.title: Royal visit to Binyamin: King of the Warri Kingdom of Nigeria visits the Land of the Bible
item.description: Extraordinary royal visit to Binyamin: King of the Warri Kingdom of Nigeria tours Psagot Winery and ancient Shiloh as Binyamin works to expand ties with African leaders.

item.title: Southern Command Chief issues warning to Hamas
item.description: Southern Command chief issues warning to Hamas at ceremony in Eshkol: “Any attempt to attack IDF soldiers or residents of the Negev will be met with a sharp response."

item.title: Severe poisoning attack kills nine sheep, shepherding dog near Alon Road
item.description: Terrorists from al-Mughayyir poisoned a livestock trough near Alon Road, affecting 50 sheep, killing nine and a shepherding dog as security forces launched searches.

item.title: Watch: Motorcyclist runs over police officer in Lod and flees
item.description: Police attempted to stop a motorcyclist for inspection in Lod. He allegedly fled, struck an officer and lightly injured him.

item.title: Israeli dies in Namibia: Doctor recognizes ZAKA volunteer and cancels autopsy
item.description: A pathologist in Namibia recognized ZAKA volunteer Yossi Landau from a deadly plane crash 19 years ago and agreed to release an Israeli traveler’s body without an autopsy.

item.title: John Cleese reported to UK counter-terrorism program over Islam criticism
item.description: A complaint accuses the comedian of “demonising" and “dehumanising" Muslims. Cleese’s response? “I can’t wait to be arrested."

item.title: Member of European Parliament knocks over Israeli flag at 10/7 memorial exhibition
item.description: Rima Hassan faces backlash over removing an Israeli flag from an October 7 memorial exhibition. France’s Foreign Minister said the allegations, if true, warrant EU sanctions.

item.title: ‘Sensitive period’: Security establishment prepares for threats to elections
item.description: IDF Chief of Staff, Police Commissioner, and Shin Bet chief hold multi-front situation assessment and agree on a series of measures aimed at ensuring the elections are held safely and without disruption.

item.title: 1,200 crew members - including from Syria and Lebanon entered Israel
item.description: Since the beginning of the year, more than 1,200 foreign airline crew members from countries without diplomatic ties with Israel, including Syria, Lebanon, and Oman, have entered the country.

item.title: Beverly Hills Rabbi builds a new community in Jerusalem
item.description: This Friday: brunch and site tour in Givat HaMatos with Rabbi Kalman Topp. Explore the new neighborhood and hear the vision behind the new Anglo community, Ahavat Yisrael.

item.title: This week: Six heroes of Dubai flight to receive Presidential Medal
item.description: President Isaac Herzog will present Israel’s highest civilian award for heroism this week to six Israelis who acted to save the passengers of the Dubai-Tel Aviv flight.

item.title: ‘Time for him to pay’: Nova security chief sues Ronen Bar over October 7
item.description: Nova security chief sues Ronen Bar for NIS 2.5 million, alleging he failed to pass on critical warnings that could have saved lives on October 7, 'He did not pass on vital information, he is responsible for this massacre.'
